name: omacal Calendar
author: Gerry
description: CalDAV-backed calendar popup for the Omarchy bar clock. Shows events from your CalDAV calendars in a month grid and day view, with add/edit/delete, recurring events, and a first-run setup flow.

barWidget.description: Date/time label with a CalDAV calendar popup (month grid + day view, add/edit/delete, recurring events).
